source.title: Fermanagh Herald, 26 April 1924, p. 5
source.publisher: Fermanagh Herald (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: Re-cited 6 Nov 2026: the Fermanagh Herald's Enniskillen Rural Council nomination list prints 'DRUMANE—John James Dowler'.

note: Reconstitution of Enniskillen rural district council. Twenty-three Unionist candidates were nominated for the twenty-six divisions and, there being no Nationalist nominations, were returned unopposed; no candidates came forward for three divisions (Belfast News-Letter, 24 April 1924). The printed list names twenty-two of the twenty-three successful candidates; the remaining name is not legible and is omitted. Unopposed Unionist nomination. Returned unopposed.
